title: Oxva Nexlim 2 Mini Pod Vape Kit
description: The OXVA Nexlim 2 Mini Kit offers exceptional performance within a highly portable, aerospace-grade aluminium chassis. Designed for vapers who need a dependable daily setup, this slim device houses a substantial 1500mAh battery capable of delivering up to 30W of power. Thanks to highly efficient power management, it provides extended vaping sessions, potentially lasting several days on a single charge depending on your selected settings*. When a top-up is needed, the 2A USB-C fast charging connection quickly restores the battery to 80 percent capacity in approximately 30 minutes. Operating the Nexlim 2 Mini is highly intuitive. It features an innovative touch switch that allows you to effortlessly toggle between a battery-conserving ECO mode and a flavour-enhancing BOOST mode with a simple double tap. A clear three-colour LED indicator keeps you informed of your current battery status, while the precise airflow slider on the side lets you fine-tune your draw for a perfectly tailored inhale. The kit includes a 2ml UNITECH 3.0 Nexlim pod, which utilises advanced leak-resistant technology and a convenient top-fill design for clean maintenance. Inside, the integrated dual mesh coils provide rapid heating and consistent flavour delivery from the first draw to the last. Supplied with a 0.8ohm pod, this kit is perfectly suited for mouth-to-lung vaping when paired with your preferred 50/50 e-liquids and Nicotine Salts. *Battery longevity is dependent on selected mode and individual vaping frequency. We recommend paring this kit with the following e-liquids: OXVA NEXLIM V2 Side Fill 0.6ohm RDTL - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids OXVA NEXLIM V2 Side Fill 0.8ohm MTL - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids OXVA NEXLIM V2 Side Fill 1.2ohm MTL - Use 50/50 Freebase Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
